capabilities: save default sort order for the backlinks pane
set default collapse behavior for backlink results
set default 'show more context' option for backlink results
apply saved settings to the backlinks pane each time a file is opened
extras: Available in the official Community Plugins repository.
intentEvidence: allows users to save preferred settings for the backlinks / "Linked mentions" pane at the bottom of notes
problem: Obsidian resets the backlinks pane's settings every time a file is opened, forcing users to re-configure sort order, collapsing, and context display each time.
summary: Settings plugin that saves default sort order, collapse, and context options for the backlinks pane so they persist across files.
